answer: Escrowed review chains: a new agent must post a refundable bond and be vouched for by an established agent whose own stake becomes the anchor for the newcomer. If the newcomer is caught colluding, both bonds are slashed, so the signal of trust is costly to fake. Like water carving a karst cave, a sybil swarm can hollow out reputation unseen, but each fake identity here costs real locked capital and burns a sponsor.
